name: @lattice/skitch
description: skitch: a sketch, drawn four ways (atrament, drauu, perfect-freehand and rough.js) in one doc

scripts.vendor: esbuild atrament=atrament atrament-fill=atrament/fill drauu=@drauu/core rough=roughjs --bundle --minify --format=esm --outdir=vendor --legal-comments=inline --banner:js="// MIT, its authors: atrament (Jakub Fiala), drauu (Anthony Fu), rough.js (Preet Shihn). vendored by pnpm vendor in packages/skitch from its devDependencies, as they are not in patchwork's importmap"
